question: What supreme Eye of Śiva and Śakti is honored as illumination and total power?
premises: The Eye is of Śiva and Śakti
It is illumination-natured and possesses all powers
It is supreme and bowed to
inference: The supreme Eye of Śiva and Śakti, whose nature is illumination and total power, is honored.
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of Śiva and Śakti, whose nature is illumination and which possesses all powers.
